name: Sosna Mielnicka (Parasolka)

location.address: Roadside at the entrance to Mielnik from the Siemiatycze direction, Mielnik, Podlaskie Voivodeship

access: Free, roadside, visible from a public road at the village entrance; no restriction found
transport: Roadside at Mielnik village entrance; no public transport data found, drivable
verify_notes: Nicknamed 'Parasolka' (umbrella) for its wide, dense, umbrella-shaped crown, the town's unofficial signature tree. Designated pomnik przyrody by a 1996 ordinance of the Bialystok Voivode (register/tourist-board source podlasie.siemiatycze.pl, which reproduces the designation, gives coordinates 52.33942/23.00541 matching this lead's coordinate within a few metres, age ~120 years at designation, girth 353cm, height 14m). CONFLICTS with a 2023 professional tomograph examination (dendrology firm 'Sosenka' of Szczecin, reported by radio.bialystok.pl and podlasie24.pl) which dated the tree at 245 years and found it in very good health despite an old lightning-strike scar, a burned/hollowed patch and historic resin-tapping damage on the trunk facing the road, plus a longitudinal crack. Neither source is dismissed; both figures recorded, do not pick a winner. Alive and healthy as of the 2023 assessment, which is the most recent evidence. No other named remarkable tree found yet in Mielnik itself, so this may work best as a single roadside stop on a wider Podlasie/Mielnik area page rather than a solo single-tree place (a modest-sized pine, not obviously a destination on its own merit) -- leave the container decision to a later pass.
held_2026-09-17: Verified and complete, but not written up or published this pass. Its own verify_notes call it 'not obviously a destination on its own merit', no festival, record-claim or notable figure attaches to it beyond the register designation and a 2023 health check, and no nearby published city exists to fold it into honestly (nearest register/city work is Siemiatycze/Bialystok, neither published). Sibling candidate zrz_001 in the same batch was published standalone on a stronger fame signal (national Tree of the Year contest entry, specific family folklore); this one was held rather than matched to keep the single-famous-tree bar meaningful. Recorded in CURATION.md and LOG.md 2026-09-17. Re-open if a Podlasie cluster of other monumental trees ever gets verified, or if a future pass finds a stronger fame signal.
